description: Major Canadian Oil and Natural Gas Pipelines: Key Attributes is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. This dataset provides summary information on major Canadian oil and natural gas pipeline systems regulated by the Canada Energy Regulator (CER). It compiles key attributes and information for each pipeline system, such as location, transported commodities, and links to pipeline maps and regulatory documents. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Its tags are Pipeline, pipeline system, pipeline attributes, pipeline description, pipeline length. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-02-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
